# 0 setup and options
## 0.1 setup
```{r setup, purl = T}
rm(list=ls())
gc()

# load packages
first_use_packages <- FALSE 
#KnitroR will not be installed 

pkglst <- c("ggplot2", "dplyr", "readxl", "stringr", "tidyr", "hutils", "matrixcalc", "rlang", "openxlsx", "Hmisc") #, "KnitroR"
if (first_use_packages) {
  for (pkg in pkglst) {
    if (!(pkg %in% rownames(installed.packages()))) {
      install.packages(pkg, dependencies = TRUE)
    }
  }
}
#update.packages(checkBuilt = TRUE, oldPkgs = pkglst, ask = FALSE)
for (pkg in pkglst) {
  library(pkg, character.only = TRUE)
}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
select <- dplyr::select

# set options 
## specifications
wasp <- "fw" 
# wage specification: "fw" for fixed wages, "vw" for variable wages
utfu <- "bc"
# utility function: "bc" for BoxCox, "tl" for translog
gsur <- TRUE
# use of group-specific unemployment rate
oli <- "lim"
# out-of-labor income:
#   "lim" for no unemployment benefits or social assistance (only exceptions)
#   "bsa" for full take up of simulated social assistance
#   "dat" for unemployment benefits and social assistance as recorded in data 
#   "mix" for full take up of simulated social assistance and unemployment benefits as recorded in data
## paths
workingdirectory <- "J:/GHUM-FEB-CES4-SRV-DATA/tempSVH/CH3/RRURO_2025/"
EMfolder <- "J:/GHUM-FEB-CES4-SRV-DATA/tempSVH/CH3/RRURO_2025/BE_master_BE_ITT/"
inputfolder <- paste0(workingdirectory, "Input/")
outputfolder <- paste0(workingdirectory, "Output")
IEMO <- paste0(inputfolder, "EM-output/")
ISCS <- paste0(inputfolder, "EM-SILC-choicesets/")

## other options 
new_choicesets <- FALSE
new_pdata <- FALSE
new_simulation_ruro <- FALSE
new_simulation_duro <- FALSE
sizecs <- 100 #for now max 100, otherwise problems with id's)
options(scipen = 15)

# for model vars
w_max <- 120
h_max <- 170
years <- c(2015, 2017, 2019)

#functions
source(paste0(workingdirectory, "Ruro_functions_EMRWS.R"))

#external information
##CPI and minimum wages
mw_CPI_tab <- as.data.frame(read_xlsx(paste0(inputfolder, "external input.xlsx"), sheet = "mw_CPI"))
##group-specific unemployment rate
if (gsur) {
  gsurtab <- as.data.frame(read_xlsx(paste0(inputfolder, "external input.xlsx"), sheet = "gsurSB"))
} else {
  gsurtab <- as.data.frame(read_xlsx(paste0(inputfolder, "external input.xlsx"), sheet = "gsurONE"))
}
gsurtab_long <- gsurtab %>% pivot_longer(starts_with("Y"), names_to = "year", values_to = "GSURate") %>% mutate(category_year = paste0(category, "_", as.numeric(str_sub(year, -4))))
##evolution of consumer prices on 4 digit-level
pricetable <- ff_read_price_evolution(inputfolder, excel = "Indexen per productgroep vanaf 2006.xls", tab = "CPI-IPC 2013 = 100")

param_wai <- read.csv2(paste0(inputfolder, "param_100cs_", wasp, ifelse(gsur, "_gsur_", "_nogsur_"), oli, "_woles_wai.csv"))[-c(1,2), -1]
```

# 3. RURO
## 3.1 Load RURO data and prepare data
```{r}
if (new_pdata){
  em_full_2019 <- read.delim2(paste0(IEMO, "lma/be_2019_std.txt"), dec = ",")
  em_full_2019 <- em_full_2019 %>% group_by(idhh) %>% mutate(
    hh_size = n(),
    children0_13 = sum(dag <= 13),
    eqscale = (1 + 0.5*(hh_size - 1 - children0_13) + 0.3*children0_13),
    eqincome = sum(ils_dispy)/(1 + 0.5*(hh_size - 1 - children0_13) + 0.3*children0_13) 
  ) %>% ungroup()
  
  #choice sets
  aux_b <- read.delim2(paste0(ISCS, "aux_2019_wai_sim.txt"), dec = ".")
  #baseline
  em_s_b <- read.delim2(paste0(IEMO, "be_2019_std_s.txt"), dec = ",")
  em_c_b <- read.delim2(paste0(IEMO, "be_2019_std_c.txt"), dec = ",")
  em_b <- rbind(em_s_b, em_c_b)
  rm(em_s_b, em_c_b)
  samp <- left_join(em_b, aux_b, by = "idperson")
  rm(em_b, aux_b)
  gc()
  samp <- samp %>% mutate(dwt = round(dwt, digits = 4), 
                          eqscale = em_full_2019$eqscale[match(idhh_true, em_full_2019$idhh)])
  
  #  samp_test <- samp_b %>% group_by(idorigperson) %>% mutate(
  #  ils_dispy_oli_mean = ifelse(lma == 0, NA, mean(ifelse(hours == 0, ils_dispy, NA), na.rm = T)),
  #  ils_dispy_oli_min = ifelse(lma == 0, NA, min(ifelse(hours == 0, ils_dispy, NA), na.rm = T)), 
  #  ils_dispy_oli_max = ifelse(lma == 0, NA, max(ifelse(hours == 0, ils_dispy, NA), na.rm = T))
  #) %>% ungroup() %>% mutate(
  #  dif_ils_dispy_oli = ifelse(hours == 0, ils_dispy - ils_dispy_oli_mean, NA),
  #  dif_oliminmax = ils_dispy_oli_min - ils_dispy_oli_max
  #)
  #samp_val <- samp_test %>% filter(idhh_true %in% (samp_test %>% filter(abs(dif_ils_dispy_oli) > 0.01) %>% pull(idhh_true)))
  #View(head(samp_val %>% select(idhh, idhh_true, idorigperson, idpersonorig, lma, hours, ils_dispy, ils_dispy_oli_min, ils_dispy_oli_mean, ils_dispy_oli_max, dif_ils_dispy_oli, dif_oliminmax), 500))
  
  #UBI
  #determine median (net) (employment) income
  UBI_30 <- round(0.3 * weighted_quantile(em_full_2019$ils_dispy, em_full_2019$dwt, p=0.5))
  UBI_50 <- round(0.5 * weighted_quantile(em_full_2019$ils_dispy, em_full_2019$dwt, p=0.5))
  rm(em_full_2019)
  gc()
  
  samp <- samp %>% mutate (
    u3 = ifelse(dag >= 18 & dag < 65, 
                pmax(0, UBI_30 - (bsa_s + pmax(0, bun - ifelse(il_taxabley_bf_mq == 0, 0, (bun/il_taxabley_bf_mq)*ils_tax))
                                  + pmax(0, ils_earns - ils_sicdy - ifelse(il_taxabley_bf_mq == 0, 0, (il_acty/il_taxabley_bf_mq)*ils_tax)))),
                0), 
    u5 = ifelse(dag >= 18 & dag < 65, 
                pmax(0, UBI_50 - (bsa_s + pmax(0, bun - ifelse(il_taxabley_bf_mq == 0, 0, (bun/il_taxabley_bf_mq)*ils_tax))
                                  + pmax(0, ils_earns - ils_sicdy - ifelse(il_taxabley_bf_mq == 0, 0, (il_acty/il_taxabley_bf_mq)*ils_tax)))),
                0),
    uc3 = ifelse(dag >= 18 & dag < 65, 
                 pmax(0, UBI_30 - (bsa_s + pmax(0, bun - ifelse(il_taxabley_bf_mq == 0, 0, (bun/il_taxabley_bf_mq)*ils_tax))
                                  + 0.5*pmax(0, (ils_earns - ils_sicdy - ifelse(il_taxabley_bf_mq == 0, 0, (il_acty/il_taxabley_bf_mq)*ils_tax))))),
                 0),
    uc5 = ifelse(dag >= 18 & dag < 65, 
                 pmax(0, UBI_50 - (bsa_s + pmax(0, bun - ifelse(il_taxabley_bf_mq == 0, 0, (bun/il_taxabley_bf_mq)*ils_tax))
                                   + 0.5*pmax(0, (ils_earns - ils_sicdy - ifelse(il_taxabley_bf_mq == 0, 0, (il_acty/il_taxabley_bf_mq)*ils_tax))))),
                 0),
    ils_dispy_u3 = ils_dispy + u3, 
    ils_dispy_u5 = ils_dispy + u5, 
    ils_dispy_uc3 = ils_dispy + uc3,
    ils_dispy_uc5 = ils_dispy + uc5
  )
  saveRDS(samp, file = paste0(inputfolder, "EM-SILC-choicesets/samp_b.RDS"))

  pdata_b <- f_preparedata_sim(samp, "fw", gsurtab_long, mw_CPI_tab, wri = FALSE)
  saveRDS(pdata_b, file = paste0(inputfolder, "EM-SILC-choicesets/pdata_b.RDS"))
  pdata_u3 <- f_preparedata_sim(samp %>% mutate(ils_dispy = ils_dispy_u3, ubi = u3, ubi_rec = ifelse(ubi>0, 1, 0)), 
                                "fw", gsurtab_long, mw_CPI_tab, wri = FALSE)
  saveRDS(pdata_u3, file = paste0(inputfolder, "EM-SILC-choicesets/pdata_u3.RDS"))
  pdata_u5 <- f_preparedata_sim(samp %>% mutate(ils_dispy = ils_dispy_u5, ubi = u5, ubi_rec = ifelse(ubi>0, 1, 0)), 
                                "fw", gsurtab_long, mw_CPI_tab, wri = FALSE)
  saveRDS(pdata_u5, file = paste0(inputfolder, "EM-SILC-choicesets/pdata_u5.RDS"))
  pdata_uc3 <- f_preparedata_sim(samp %>% mutate(ils_dispy = ils_dispy_uc3, ubi = uc3, ubi_rec = ifelse(ubi>0, 1, 0)), 
                                 "fw", gsurtab_long, mw_CPI_tab, wri = FALSE)
  saveRDS(pdata_uc3, file = paste0(inputfolder, "EM-SILC-choicesets/pdata_uc3.RDS"))
  pdata_uc5 <- f_preparedata_sim(samp %>% mutate(ils_dispy = ils_dispy_uc5, ubi = uc5, ubi_rec = ifelse(ubi>0, 1, 0)), 
                                 "fw", gsurtab_long, mw_CPI_tab, wri = FALSE)
  saveRDS(pdata_uc5, file = paste0(inputfolder, "EM-SILC-choicesets/pdata_uc5.RDS"))
}
```

## 3.2 Simulate with error terms
```{r}
if (new_simulation_ruro){
  if (!exists("pdata_b")){
    pdata_b <- readRDS(paste0(inputfolder, "EM-SILC-choicesets/pdata_b.RDS"))
    pdata_u3 <- readRDS(paste0(inputfolder, "EM-SILC-choicesets/pdata_u3.RDS"))
    pdata_u5 <- readRDS(paste0(inputfolder, "EM-SILC-choicesets/pdata_u5.RDS"))
    pdata_uc3 <- readRDS(paste0(inputfolder, "EM-SILC-choicesets/pdata_uc3.RDS"))
    pdata_uc5 <- readRDS(paste0(inputfolder, "EM-SILC-choicesets/pdata_uc5.RDS"))
  }
  f_simul4 <- function(param, sm_b, sf_b, cou_b, 
                       sm_r1, sf_r1, cou_r1, 
                       sm_r2, sf_r2, cou_r2, 
                       sm_r3, sf_r3, cou_r3, 
                       sm_r4, sf_r4, cou_r4, draws){  
  sm_b <- ff_calc_util(param, sm_b, "sm")
  sm_r1 <- ff_calc_util(param, sm_r1, "sm")
  sm_r2 <- ff_calc_util(param, sm_r2, "sm")
  sm_r3 <- ff_calc_util(param, sm_r3, "sm")
  sm_r4 <- ff_calc_util(param, sm_r4, "sm")
  sf_b <- ff_calc_util(param, sf_b, "sf")
  sf_r1 <- ff_calc_util(param, sf_r1, "sf")
  sf_r2 <- ff_calc_util(param, sf_r2, "sf")
  sf_r3 <- ff_calc_util(param, sf_r3, "sf")
  sf_r4 <- ff_calc_util(param, sf_r4, "sf")
  cou_b <- ff_calc_util(param, cou_b, "cou")
  cou_r1 <- ff_calc_util(param, cou_r1, "cou")
  cou_r2 <- ff_calc_util(param, cou_r2, "cou")
  cou_r3 <- ff_calc_util(param, cou_r3, "cou")
  cou_r4 <- ff_calc_util(param, cou_r4, "cou")
  
  for (i in 1:draws){
    print(paste0("draw ", i))
    set.seed(i)
    sm <- ff_predchoice4(sm_b, sm_r1, sm_r2, sm_r3, sm_r4)
    sm_b <- sm$df_b %>% rename_at(vars("gumb_draw", "util_tot"), ~ paste0(., i))
    sm_r1 <- sm$df_r1 %>% rename_at(vars("gumb_draw", "util_tot", "pred_choice"), ~ paste0(., i))
    sm_r2 <- sm$df_r2 %>% rename_at(vars("gumb_draw", "util_tot", "pred_choice"), ~ paste0(., i))
    sm_r3 <- sm$df_r3 %>% rename_at(vars("gumb_draw", "util_tot", "pred_choice"), ~ paste0(., i))
    sm_r4 <- sm$df_r4 %>% rename_at(vars("gumb_draw", "util_tot", "pred_choice"), ~ paste0(., i))
    sf <- ff_predchoice4(sf_b, sf_r1, sf_r2, sf_r3, sf_r4)
    sf_b <- sf$df_b %>% rename_at(vars("gumb_draw", "util_tot"), ~ paste0(., i))
    sf_r1 <- sf$df_r1 %>% rename_at(vars("gumb_draw", "util_tot", "pred_choice"), ~ paste0(., i))
    sf_r2 <- sf$df_r2 %>% rename_at(vars("gumb_draw", "util_tot", "pred_choice"), ~ paste0(., i))
    sf_r3 <- sf$df_r3 %>% rename_at(vars("gumb_draw", "util_tot", "pred_choice"), ~ paste0(., i))
    sf_r4 <- sf$df_r4 %>% rename_at(vars("gumb_draw", "util_tot", "pred_choice"), ~ paste0(., i))
    cou <- ff_predchoice4(cou_b, cou_r1, cou_r2, cou_r3, cou_r4)
    cou_b <- cou$df_b %>% rename_at(vars("gumb_draw", "util_tot"), ~ paste0(., i))
    cou_r1 <- cou$df_r1 %>% rename_at(vars("gumb_draw", "util_tot", "pred_choice"), ~ paste0(., i))
    cou_r2 <- cou$df_r2 %>% rename_at(vars("gumb_draw", "util_tot", "pred_choice"), ~ paste0(., i))
    cou_r3 <- cou$df_r3 %>% rename_at(vars("gumb_draw", "util_tot", "pred_choice"), ~ paste0(., i))
    cou_r4 <- cou$df_r4 %>% rename_at(vars("gumb_draw", "util_tot", "pred_choice"), ~ paste0(., i))
  }
  if (draws > 1){
    sm_r1 <- sm_r1 %>% mutate(exp = rowSums(across(starts_with("pred_choice")))/draws)
    sm_r2 <- sm_r2 %>% mutate(exp = rowSums(across(starts_with("pred_choice")))/draws)
    sm_r3 <- sm_r3 %>% mutate(exp = rowSums(across(starts_with("pred_choice")))/draws)
    sm_r4 <- sm_r4 %>% mutate(exp = rowSums(across(starts_with("pred_choice")))/draws)
    sf_r1 <- sf_r1 %>% mutate(exp = rowSums(across(starts_with("pred_choice")))/draws)
    sf_r2 <- sf_r2 %>% mutate(exp = rowSums(across(starts_with("pred_choice")))/draws)
    sf_r3 <- sf_r3 %>% mutate(exp = rowSums(across(starts_with("pred_choice")))/draws)
    sf_r4 <- sf_r4 %>% mutate(exp = rowSums(across(starts_with("pred_choice")))/draws)
    cou_r1 <- cou_r1 %>% mutate(exp = rowSums(across(starts_with("pred_choice")))/draws)
    cou_r2 <- cou_r2 %>% mutate(exp = rowSums(across(starts_with("pred_choice")))/draws)
    cou_r3 <- cou_r3 %>% mutate(exp = rowSums(across(starts_with("pred_choice")))/draws)
    cou_r4 <- cou_r4 %>% mutate(exp = rowSums(across(starts_with("pred_choice")))/draws)
  } else{
    sm_r1 <- sm_r1 %>% mutate(exp = pred_choice1)
    sm_r2 <- sm_r2 %>% mutate(exp = pred_choice1)
    sm_r3 <- sm_r3 %>% mutate(exp = pred_choice1)
    sm_r4 <- sm_r4 %>% mutate(exp = pred_choice1)
    sf_r1 <- sf_r1 %>% mutate(exp = pred_choice1)
    sf_r2 <- sf_r2 %>% mutate(exp = pred_choice1)
    sf_r3 <- sf_r3 %>% mutate(exp = pred_choice1)
    sf_r4 <- sf_r4 %>% mutate(exp = pred_choice1)
    cou_r1 <- cou_r1 %>% mutate(exp = pred_choice1)
    cou_r2 <- cou_r2 %>% mutate(exp = pred_choice1)
    cou_r3 <- cou_r3 %>% mutate(exp = pred_choice1)
    cou_r4 <- cou_r4 %>% mutate(exp = pred_choice1)
  }
  return(list("sm_b"=sm_b, "sf_b"=sf_b, "cou_b"=cou_b, 
              "sm_r1"=sm_r1, "sf_r1"=sf_r1, "cou_r1"=cou_r1, 
              "sm_r2"=sm_r2, "sf_r2"=sf_r2, "cou_r2"=cou_r2, 
              "sm_r3"=sm_r3, "sf_r3"=sf_r3, "cou_r3"=cou_r3, 
              "sm_r4"=sm_r4, "sf_r4"=sf_r4, "cou_r4"=cou_r4))
  } 
  ff_predchoice4 <- function(df_b, df_r1, df_r2, df_r3, df_r4){
  df_b <- ff_gumbel_draw(df_b, uncond = FALSE)
  df_r1 <- df_r1 %>% mutate(
    gumb_draw = df_b$gumb_draw[match(idhh, df_b$idhh)],
    util_tot = util + gumb_draw
  )
  id_pc1 <- df_r1 %>% group_by(idhh_true) %>% slice(which.max(util_tot)) %>% pull(idhh)
  df_r1 <- df_r1 %>% mutate(pred_choice = ifelse(idhh %in% id_pc1, 1, 0))
  df_r2 <- df_r2 %>% mutate(
    gumb_draw = df_b$gumb_draw[match(idhh, df_b$idhh)],
    util_tot = util + gumb_draw
  )
  id_pc2 <- df_r2 %>% group_by(idhh_true) %>% slice(which.max(util_tot)) %>% pull(idhh)
  df_r2 <- df_r2 %>% mutate(pred_choice = ifelse(idhh %in% id_pc2, 1, 0))
  df_r3 <- df_r3 %>% mutate(
    gumb_draw = df_b$gumb_draw[match(idhh, df_b$idhh)],
    util_tot = util + gumb_draw
  )
  id_pc3 <- df_r3 %>% group_by(idhh_true) %>% slice(which.max(util_tot)) %>% pull(idhh)
  df_r3 <- df_r3 %>% mutate(pred_choice = ifelse(idhh %in% id_pc3, 1, 0))
  df_r4 <- df_r4 %>% mutate(
    gumb_draw = df_b$gumb_draw[match(idhh, df_b$idhh)],
    util_tot = util + gumb_draw
  )
  id_pc4 <- df_r4 %>% group_by(idhh_true) %>% slice(which.max(util_tot)) %>% pull(idhh)
  df_r4 <- df_r4 %>% mutate(pred_choice = ifelse(idhh %in% id_pc4, 1, 0))
  return(list("df_b"= df_b, "df_r1"= df_r1, "df_r2"=df_r2, "df_r3"=df_r3, "df_r4"=df_r4))
}
  
  set.seed(1)
  sdata <- f_simul4(param_wai, 
                    pdata_b$sm, pdata_b$sf, pdata_b$cou, 
                    pdata_u3$sm, pdata_u3$sf, pdata_u3$cou, 
                    pdata_u5$sm, pdata_u5$sf, pdata_u5$cou, 
                    pdata_uc3$sm, pdata_uc3$sf, pdata_uc3$cou,
                    pdata_uc5$sm, pdata_uc5$sf, pdata_uc5$cou, 100)
  #rm(pdata_b, pdata_u3, pdata_u5, pdata_uc3, pdata_uc5)
  gc()
  #saveRDS(sdata, file = paste0(inputfolder, "sdata.RDS"))
  
  ems_u3 <- f_em_exp(sdata$sm_b, sdata$sf_b, sdata$cou_b, sdata$sm_r1, sdata$sf_r1, sdata$cou_r1)
  ems_u5 <- f_em_exp(sdata$sm_b, sdata$sf_b, sdata$cou_b, sdata$sm_r2, sdata$sf_r2, sdata$cou_r2)
  ems_uc3 <- f_em_exp(sdata$sm_b, sdata$sf_b, sdata$cou_b, sdata$sm_r3, sdata$sf_r3, sdata$cou_r3)
  ems_uc5 <- f_em_exp(sdata$sm_b, sdata$sf_b, sdata$cou_b, sdata$sm_r4, sdata$sf_r4, sdata$cou_r4)
  rm(sdata)
  gc()
  
  f_em_merge4 <- function(em_r1, em_r2, em_r3, em_r4, varlist_b, varlist_b_com, varlist_r, varlist_r_com){
  varlist_b_s <- paste0(c(varlist_b_com, varlist_b),".obs")
  varlist_b_c <- paste0(c(varlist_b_com, paste0(varlist_b, "_m"), paste0(varlist_b, "_f")), ".obs")
  varlist_r_s <- c(paste0(c(varlist_r_com, varlist_r), ".for"),paste0(c(varlist_r_com, varlist_r), ".exp"))
  varlist_r_c <- c(paste0(c(varlist_r_com, paste0(varlist_r, "_m"), paste0(varlist_r, "_f")), ".for"), paste0(c(varlist_r_com, paste0(varlist_r, "_m"), paste0(varlist_r, "_f")), ".exp"))
  
  for (i in c("sm", "sf", "coum", "couf")){
    print(i)
    if(i == "sm"){
      df1 = em_r1$sm
      df2 = em_r2$sm
      df3 = em_r3$sm
      df4 = em_r4$sm
      varlist_b <- varlist_b_s
      varlist_r <- varlist_r_s
    } else if (i == "sf"){
      df1 = em_r1$sf
      df2 = em_r2$sf
      df3 = em_r3$sf
      df4 = em_r4$sf
      varlist_b <- varlist_b_s
      varlist_r <- varlist_r_s
    } else if (i == "coum"|i == "couf"){
      df1 = em_r1$cou
      df2 = em_r2$cou
      df3 = em_r3$cou
      df4 = em_r4$cou
      varlist_b <- varlist_b_c
      varlist_r <- varlist_r_c
    } 
    df_all <- left_join(df1 %>% select(idhh_true, all_of(varlist_b)), 
                        df1 %>% select(idhh_true, all_of(varlist_r)) %>% rename_at(vars(all_of(varlist_r)), ~ str_c(., "_r1")), by = "idhh_true")
    df_all <- left_join(df_all, df2 %>% select(idhh_true, all_of(varlist_r)) %>% rename_at(vars(all_of(varlist_r)), ~ str_c(., "_r2")), by = "idhh_true")
    
    df_all <- left_join(df_all, df3 %>% select(idhh_true, all_of(varlist_r)) %>% rename_at(vars(all_of(varlist_r)), ~ str_c(., "_r3")), by = "idhh_true")
    
    df_all <- left_join(df_all, df4 %>% select(idhh_true, all_of(varlist_r)) %>% rename_at(vars(all_of(varlist_r)), ~ str_c(., "_r4")), by = "idhh_true")
    df_all <- df_all %>% mutate(group = i)
    if (i == "coum"){df_all <- df_all %>% select(-contains("_f")) %>% rename_at(vars(contains("_m")), ~ str_remove(., "_m"))}
    if (i == "couf"){df_all <- df_all %>% select(-contains("_m")) %>% rename_at(vars(contains("_f")), ~ str_remove(., "_f"))}
    if (i == "sm"){sm_all <- df_all} else if (i == "sf"){sf_all <- df_all} else if (i == "coum"){coum_all <- df_all}else if (i == "couf"){couf_all <- df_all}
  }
  em_all <- rbind(sm_all, sf_all, coum_all, couf_all)
  return(em_all)
}

  varlist_b_com <- c("dwt")
  varlist_b <- c("idperson", "idpersonorig", "eqincome", "hours", "working",  "ils_dispy", "ils_dispy_th", "tin_s", "tscee_s", "tsceerd_s", "tscer_s", "ils_sicdy", "ils_ben", "il_taxabley", "wage", "dag", "deh", "children", "children0_13", "yem", "tscer_hh", "ils_tax_hh", "ils_ben_hh", "ils_sicdy_hh")
  varlist_r_com <- c()
  varlist_r <- c("eqincome", "hours", "working",  "ils_dispy", "ils_dispy_th", "tin_s", "tscee_s", "tsceerd_s", "tscer_s", "ils_sicdy", "ils_ben", "il_taxabley", "wage", "yem", "tscer_hh", "ils_tax_hh", "ils_ben_hh", "ils_sicdy_hh", "ubi", "ubi_rec")
  
  em_ruro <- f_em_merge4(ems_u3, ems_u5, ems_uc3, ems_uc5, varlist_b, varlist_b_com, varlist_r, varlist_r_com)
  rm(ems_u3, ems_u5, ems_uc3, ems_uc5)
  gc()

  em_for_wage <- read.delim2(paste0(IEMO, "lma/BE_2019_std.txt"), dec = ",") %>% select(idperson, yivwg)
  
  em_ruro <- em_ruro %>% mutate(yivwg = em_for_wage$yivwg[match(idperson.obs, em_for_wage$idperson)])
  qui_wag <- weighted_quantile(em_ruro$yivwg, em_ruro$dwt.obs, seq(0,1, 0.2))
  em_ruro <- em_ruro %>% mutate(quiwag = case_when(yivwg<=qui_wag[2] ~ 1,
                                                   yivwg<=qui_wag[3] ~ 2,
                                                   yivwg<=qui_wag[4] ~ 3,
                                                   yivwg<=qui_wag[5] ~ 4,
                                                   yivwg<=qui_wag[6] ~ 5)
  )
  
  em_ruro <- em_ruro %>% filter(ils_dispy_th.obs >= 0)
  
  em_ruro <- em_ruro %>% mutate(BS = ifelse(group %in% c("sm", "sf"), "single", "couple"),
                                GE = ifelse(group %in% c("sm", "coum"), "male", "female"))
  
  em_ruro <- em_ruro %>% rename_at(vars(ends_with(c("_r1", "_r2", "_r3", "_r4"))), 
                                   ~ str_replace(str_replace(str_replace(str_replace(., "_r1", "_u3"), 
                                                                         "_r2", "_u5"), 
                                                             "_r3", "_uc3"), 
                                                 "_r4", "_uc5"))
  gc()
  saveRDS(em_ruro, paste0(inputfolder, "em_ruro.RDS"))
}
```

## 3.3 Simulate without error terms
```{r}
if (new_simulation_duro){
  # start from samp or pdata?
  print("load pdata")
  if (!exists("pdata_b")){
    pdata_b <- readRDS(paste0(inputfolder, "EM-SILC-choicesets/pdata_b.RDS"))
    pdata_u3 <- readRDS(paste0(inputfolder, "EM-SILC-choicesets/pdata_u3.RDS"))
    pdata_u5 <- readRDS(paste0(inputfolder, "EM-SILC-choicesets/pdata_u5.RDS"))
    pdata_uc3 <- readRDS(paste0(inputfolder, "EM-SILC-choicesets/pdata_uc3.RDS"))
    pdata_uc5 <- readRDS(paste0(inputfolder, "EM-SILC-choicesets/pdata_uc5.RDS"))
  }
  # create counterfactual baseline (cfb) and simulate without error
  print("simulate")
  f_nonrandom_simul<- function(param, sm, sf, cou){
    sm <- ff_calc_util(param, sm, "sm")
    sm <- sm %>% mutate(
      choice = ifelse(idhh %in% (sm %>% group_by(idhh_true) %>% slice(which.max(util)) %>% pull(idhh)), 1, 0)
    )
    sf <- ff_calc_util(param, sf, "sf")
    sf <- sf %>% mutate(
      choice = ifelse(idhh %in% (sf %>% group_by(idhh_true) %>% slice(which.max(util)) %>% pull(idhh)), 1, 0)
    )
    cou <- ff_calc_util(param, cou, "cou")
    cou <- cou %>% mutate(
      choice = ifelse(idhh %in% (cou %>% group_by(idhh_true) %>% slice(which.max(util)) %>% pull(idhh)), 1, 0)
    )
    return(list("sm"=sm, "sf"=sf, "cou"=cou))
  }
  sd_b <- f_nonrandom_simul(param_wai, pdata_b$sm, pdata_b$sf, pdata_b$cou)
  sd_u3 <- f_nonrandom_simul(param_wai, pdata_u3$sm, pdata_u3$sf, pdata_u3$cou)
  sd_u5 <- f_nonrandom_simul(param_wai, pdata_u5$sm, pdata_u5$sf, pdata_u5$cou)
  sd_uc3 <- f_nonrandom_simul(param_wai, pdata_uc3$sm, pdata_uc3$sf, pdata_uc3$cou)
  sd_uc5 <- f_nonrandom_simul(param_wai, pdata_uc5$sm, pdata_uc5$sf, pdata_uc5$cou)
  print("merge all")
  ff_impute_cfb <- function(df_b, df_r){
    df_b <- df_b %>% mutate(cfb=ifelse(choice == 1, 1, 0))
    df_r <- df_r %>% mutate(cfb=df_b$cfb[match(idhh, df_b$idhh)])
    return(df_r)
  }
  varlist_b_com <- c("dwt")
  varlist_b <- c("idperson", "idpersonorig", "eqincome", "hours", "working",  "ils_dispy", "ils_dispy_th", "tin_s", "tscee_s", "tsceerd_s", "tscer_s", "ils_sicdy", "ils_ben", "il_taxabley", "wage", "dag", "deh", "children", "children0_13", "yem", "tscer_hh", "ils_tax_hh", "ils_ben_hh", "ils_sicdy_hh")
  varlist_r_com <- c()
  varlist_r <- c("eqincome", "hours", "working",  "ils_dispy", "ils_dispy_th", "tin_s", "tscee_s", "tsceerd_s", "tscer_s", "ils_sicdy", "ils_ben", "il_taxabley", "wage", "yem", "tscer_hh", "ils_tax_hh", "ils_ben_hh", "ils_sicdy_hh", "ubi", "ubi_rec")
  
  
  varlist_b_s <- c(varlist_b_com, varlist_b)
  varlist_b_c <- c(varlist_b_com, paste0(varlist_b, "_m"), paste0(varlist_b, "_f"))
  varlist_r_s <- c(varlist_r_com, varlist_r)
  varlist_r_c <- c(varlist_r_com, paste0(varlist_r, "_m"), paste0(varlist_r, "_f"))
  
  for (i in c("sm", "sf", "coum", "couf")) {
    print(i)
    if (i == "sm"){
      varlist_b <- varlist_b_s
      varlist_r <- varlist_r_s
      df_b <- sd_b$sm
      df_u3 <- sd_u3$sm 
      df_u5 <- sd_u5$sm 
      df_uc3 <- sd_uc3$sm 
      df_uc5 <- sd_uc5$sm
    } else if (i == "sf"){
      varlist_b <- varlist_b_s
      varlist_r <- varlist_r_s
      df_b <- sd_b$sf 
      df_u3 <- sd_u3$sf 
      df_u5 <- sd_u5$sf 
      df_uc3 <- sd_uc3$sf 
      df_uc5 <- sd_uc5$sf
    } else if (i == "coum"|i == "couf"){
      varlist_b <- varlist_b_c
      varlist_r <- varlist_r_c
      df_b <- sd_b$cou 
      df_u3 <- sd_u3$cou 
      df_u5 <- sd_u5$cou 
      df_uc3 <- sd_uc3$cou 
      df_uc5 <- sd_uc5$cou
    }
    df <- left_join(df_b %>% filter(draw == 0) %>% select(idhh_true, all_of(varlist_b)) %>% 
                      rename_at(vars(-all_of(c("idhh_true"))), ~ str_c(., ".obs")), 
                    df_b %>% filter(choice == 1) %>% select(idhh_true, all_of(varlist_b)) %>% 
                      rename_at(vars(-all_of(c("idhh_true"))), ~str_c(., ".cfb")), 
                    by = c("idhh_true"))
    df <- left_join(df, ff_impute_cfb(df_b, df_u3) %>% filter(cfb == 1) %>% select(idhh_true, all_of(varlist_r)) %>% 
                      rename_at(vars(-all_of(c("idhh_true"))), ~str_c(., ".for_u3")), 
                    by = c("idhh_true"))
    df <- left_join(df, df_u3 %>% filter(choice == 1) %>% select(idhh_true, all_of(varlist_r)) %>% 
                      rename_at(vars(-all_of(c("idhh_true"))), ~str_c(., ".exp_u3")), 
                    by = c("idhh_true"))
    df <- left_join(df, ff_impute_cfb(df_b, df_u5) %>% filter(cfb == 1) %>% select(idhh_true, all_of(varlist_r)) %>% 
                      rename_at(vars(-all_of(c("idhh_true"))), ~str_c(., ".for_u5")), 
                    by = c("idhh_true"))
    df <- left_join(df, df_u5 %>% filter(choice == 1) %>% select(idhh_true, all_of(varlist_r)) %>% 
                      rename_at(vars(-all_of(c("idhh_true"))), ~str_c(., ".exp_u5")), 
                    by = c("idhh_true"))
    df <- left_join(df, ff_impute_cfb(df_b, df_uc3) %>% filter(cfb == 1) %>% select(idhh_true, all_of(varlist_r)) %>% 
                      rename_at(vars(-all_of(c("idhh_true"))), ~str_c(., ".for_uc3")), 
                    by = c("idhh_true"))
    df <- left_join(df, df_uc3 %>% filter(choice == 1) %>% select(idhh_true, all_of(varlist_r)) %>% 
                      rename_at(vars(-all_of(c("idhh_true"))), ~str_c(., ".exp_uc3")), 
                    by = c("idhh_true"))
    df <- left_join(df, ff_impute_cfb(df_b, df_uc5) %>% filter(cfb == 1) %>% select(idhh_true, all_of(varlist_r)) %>% 
                      rename_at(vars(-all_of(c("idhh_true"))), ~str_c(., ".for_uc5")), 
                    by = c("idhh_true"))
    df <- left_join(df, df_uc5 %>% filter(choice == 1) %>% select(idhh_true, all_of(varlist_r)) %>% 
                      rename_at(vars(-all_of(c("idhh_true"))), ~str_c(., ".exp_uc5")), 
                    by = c("idhh_true"))
    df <- df %>% mutate(group = i)
    if(i == "sm"){sm<-df}
    if(i == "sf"){sf<-df}
    if(i == "coum"){coum<-df %>% select(-contains("_f")) %>% rename_at(vars(contains("_m")), ~str_remove(., "_m"))}
    if(i == "couf"){couf<-df %>% select(-contains("_m")) %>% rename_at(vars(contains("_f")), ~str_remove(., "_f"))}
  }
  em_duro <- rbind(sm, sf, coum, couf)
  rm(sd_b, sd_u3, sd_u5, sd_uc3, sd_uc5)
  gc()

  em_for_wage <- read.delim2(paste0(IEMO, "lma/BE_2019_std.txt"), dec = ",") %>% select(idperson, yivwg)
  
  em_duro <- em_duro %>% mutate(yivwg = em_for_wage$yivwg[match(idperson.obs, em_for_wage$idperson)])
  qui_wag <- weighted_quantile(em_duro$yivwg, em_duro$dwt.obs, seq(0,1, 0.2))
  em_duro <- em_duro %>% mutate(quiwag = case_when(yivwg<=qui_wag[2] ~ 1,
                                                   yivwg<=qui_wag[3] ~ 2,
                                                   yivwg<=qui_wag[4] ~ 3,
                                                   yivwg<=qui_wag[5] ~ 4,
                                                   yivwg<=qui_wag[6] ~ 5)
  )
  
  em_duro <- em_duro %>% filter(ils_dispy_th.obs >= 0)
  
  em_duro <- em_duro %>% mutate(BS = ifelse(group %in% c("sm", "sf"), "single", "couple"),
                                GE = ifelse(group %in% c("sm", "coum"), "male", "female"))
  
  saveRDS(em_duro, paste0(inputfolder, "em_duro.RDS"))
  rm(pdata_b, pdata_u3, pdata_u5, pdata_uc3, pdata_uc5,
     df, df_b, df_u3, df_u5, df_uc3, df_uc5, 
     sm, sf, couf, coum, 
     em_for_wage)
  gc()
}
```

```{r}
  difdispy_uc5 = (ils_dispy.for_uc5 - ils_dispy.obs) * 12,
  codidispy_uc3 = (ils_dispy.for_uc3 - ils_dispy.for_u3) * 12, 
  codidispy_uc5 = (ils_dispy.for_uc5 - ils_dispy.for_u5) * 12,
  
  difh_u3 = (hours.exp_u3 - hours.obs),
  difh_u5 = (hours.exp_u5 - hours.obs),
  difh_uc3 = (hours.exp_uc3 - hours.obs),
  difh_uc5 = (hours.exp_uc5 - hours.obs),
  codih_uc3 = (hours.exp_uc3 - hours.exp_u3), 
  codih_uc5 = (hours.exp_uc5 - hours.exp_u5),
  
  difh_im_u3 = ifelse(working.obs == 1 & working.exp_u3 != 0, (hours.exp_u3/working.exp_u3 - hours.obs)*working.exp_u3, 0),
  difh_im_u5 = ifelse(working.obs == 1 & working.exp_u5 != 0, (hours.exp_u5/working.exp_u5 - hours.obs)*working.exp_u5, 0),
  difh_im_uc3 = ifelse(working.obs == 1 & working.exp_uc3 != 0, (hours.exp_uc3/working.exp_uc3 - hours.obs)*working.exp_uc3, 0),
  difh_im_uc5 = ifelse(working.obs == 1 & working.exp_uc5 != 0, (hours.exp_uc5/working.exp_uc5 - hours.obs)*working.exp_uc5, 0),
  codih_im_uc3 = ifelse(working.exp_u3 != 0 & working.exp_uc3 != 0, 
                        (hours.exp_uc3/working.exp_uc3 - hours.exp_u3/working.exp_u3)*pmin(working.exp_u3, working.exp_uc3), 0), 
  codih_im_uc5 = ifelse(working.exp_u5 != 0 & working.exp_uc5 != 0, 
                        (hours.exp_uc5/working.exp_uc5 - hours.exp_u5/working.exp_u5)*pmin(working.exp_u5, working.exp_uc5), 0),
  
  difh_em_u3 = ifelse(working.obs == 0, hours.exp_u3, 0) - ifelse(working.obs == 1, hours.obs * (1 - working.exp_u3), 0),
  difh_em_u5 = ifelse(working.obs == 0, hours.exp_u5, 0) - ifelse(working.obs == 1, hours.obs * (1 - working.exp_u5), 0),
  difh_em_uc3 = ifelse(working.obs == 0, hours.exp_uc3, 0) - ifelse(working.obs == 1, hours.obs * (1 - working.exp_uc3), 0),
  difh_em_uc5 = ifelse(working.obs == 0, hours.exp_uc5, 0) - ifelse(working.obs == 1, hours.obs * (1 - working.exp_uc5), 0), 
  codih_em_uc3 = ifelse((working.exp_u3 == 0 & working.exp_uc3 == 0) | (working.exp_u3 == working.exp_uc3), 0, 
                        ifelse(working.exp_u3 == 0, hours.exp_uc3, 
                               ifelse(working.exp_uc3 == 0, -hours.exp_u3, 
                                      (working.exp_uc3 - working.exp_u3)*ifelse(working.exp_u3 > working.exp_uc3, 
                                                                                hours.exp_u3/working.exp_u3,
                                                                                hours.exp_uc3/working.exp_uc3)))),
  codih_em_uc5 = ifelse((working.exp_u5 == 0 & working.exp_uc5 == 0) | (working.exp_u5 == working.exp_uc5), 0,
                        ifelse(working.exp_u5 == 0, hours.exp_uc5, 
                               ifelse(working.exp_uc5 == 0, -hours.exp_u5,
                                      (working.exp_uc5 - working.exp_u5)*ifelse(working.exp_u5 > working.exp_uc5, 
                                                                                hours.exp_u5/working.exp_u5,
                                                                                hours.exp_uc5/working.exp_uc5)))),
  
  dify_u3 = (yem.exp_u3 - yem.obs),
  dify_u5 = (yem.exp_u5 - yem.obs),
  dify_uc3 = (yem.exp_uc3 - yem.obs),
  dify_uc5 = (yem.exp_uc5 - yem.obs), 
  
  dify_im_u3 = ifelse(working.obs == 1 & working.exp_u3 != 0, (yem.exp_u3/working.exp_u3 - yem.obs)*working.exp_u3, 0),
  dify_im_u5 = ifelse(working.obs == 1 & working.exp_u5 != 0, (yem.exp_u5/working.exp_u5 - yem.obs)*working.exp_u5, 0),
  dify_im_uc3 = ifelse(working.obs == 1 & working.exp_uc3 != 0, (yem.exp_uc3/working.exp_uc3 - yem.obs)*working.exp_uc3, 0),
  dify_im_uc5 = ifelse(working.obs == 1 & working.exp_uc5 != 0, (yem.exp_uc5/working.exp_uc5 - yem.obs)*working.exp_uc5, 0),
  codiy_im_uc3 = ifelse(working.exp_u3 != 0 & working.exp_uc3 != 0, 
                        (yem.exp_uc3/working.exp_uc3 - yem.exp_u3/working.exp_u3)*pmin(working.exp_u3, working.exp_uc3), 0),
  codiy_im_uc5 = ifelse(working.exp_u5 != 0 & working.exp_uc5 != 0, 
                        (yem.exp_uc5/working.exp_uc5 - yem.exp_u5/working.exp_u5)*pmin(working.exp_u5, working.exp_uc5), 0),
  
  dify_em_u3 = ifelse(working.obs == 0, yem.exp_u3, 0) - ifelse(working.obs == 1, yem.obs * (1 - working.exp_u3), 0),
  dify_em_u5 = ifelse(working.obs == 0, yem.exp_u5, 0) - ifelse(working.obs == 1, yem.obs * (1 - working.exp_u5), 0),
  dify_em_uc3 = ifelse(working.obs == 0, yem.exp_uc3, 0) - ifelse(working.obs == 1, yem.obs * (1 - working.exp_uc3), 0),
  dify_em_uc5 = ifelse(working.obs == 0, yem.exp_uc5, 0) - ifelse(working.obs == 1, yem.obs * (1 - working.exp_uc5), 0),
  codiy_em_uc3 = ifelse((working.exp_u3 == 0 & working.exp_uc3 == 0) | (working.exp_u3 == working.exp_uc3), 0, 
                        ifelse(working.exp_u3 == 0, yem.exp_uc3, 
                               ifelse(working.exp_uc3 == 0, -yem.exp_u3,
                                      (working.exp_uc3 - working.exp_u3)*ifelse(working.exp_u3 > working.exp_uc3, 
                                                                                yem.exp_u3/working.exp_u3, 
                                                                                yem.exp_uc3/working.exp_uc3)))),
  codiy_em_uc5 = ifelse((working.exp_u5 == 0 & working.exp_uc5 == 0) | (working.exp_u5 == working.exp_uc5), 0, 
                        ifelse(working.exp_u5 == 0, yem.exp_uc5, 
                               ifelse(working.exp_uc5 == 0, -yem.exp_u5, 
                                      (working.exp_uc5 - working.exp_u5)*ifelse(working.exp_u5 > working.exp_uc5, 
                                                                                yem.exp_u5/working.exp_u5, 
                                                                                yem.exp_uc5/working.exp_uc5))))
)
```

```{r frequentie by wage ruro}
ggplot() +
  labs(title = "", 
       subtitle = "Frequency (ths.) in RURO-subpopulation - Random URO", 
       caption = "Source: Department of Economics - KU Leuven; Simulations with Euromod, SILC and HBS", 
       x = "quintiles gross (potential) wage",
       y = "th."
  ) + 
  theme_1 +
  theme(legend.position = "right", legend.title = element_blank()) + 
  facet_grid(rows = vars(GE), cols = vars(BS)) + 
  geom_col(data = df_fig4_quiwage_ruro, 
           aes(quiwag, freq/1000), 
           alpha = 1,
           col = "darkgrey",
           fill = "darkgrey"
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, 6), ylim = c(0, 220)) +
  scale_x_continuous(expand = c(0, 0),
                     breaks = c(1,2,3,4,5),
                     labels = c(1,2,3,4,5)) + 
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0, 0))

ggsave(paste0("output/figures/frequentie quiwage ruro", ".png"),
       height = 16, width = 20, units = 'cm', dpi=330)
```

```{r data LS}
      dif_em_pos_con3 = sum(ifelse(codih_em_uc3 > 0, codih_em_uc3, 0)*dwt.obs)/sum(dwt.obs),
```

```{r ls fubi30 ruro}
ggplot(data = df_fig5_quiwage_ruro %>% filter(scenario == "u3")) +
  labs(title = "flat UBI 30% - Random URO", 
       subtitle = "mean change in hours worked", 
       caption = "Source: Department of Economics - KU Leuven; Simulations with Euromod, SILC and HBS", 
       x = "quintiles gross (potential) wage",
       y = ""
  ) + 
  theme_1 +
  theme(legend.position = "right", legend.title = element_blank()) + 
  geom_hline(aes(yintercept = 0)) + 
  facet_grid(rows = vars(GE), cols = vars(BS)) + 
  geom_col(data = df_fig5_quiwage_ruro %>% filter(marge != "totaal", scenario == "u3"), 
           aes(quiwag, dif, fill = marge), 
           alpha = 1,
           position = "stack"
  ) +
  geom_point(data = df_fig5_quiwage_ruro %>% filter(marge == "totaal", scenario == "u3"), 
             aes(quiwag, dif), 
             alpha = 1,
             col = "black",
             fill = "black"
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = colors_marge) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, 6), ylim = c(-3, 1)) +
  scale_x_continuous(expand = c(0, 0),
                     breaks = c(1,2,3,4,5),
                     labels = c(1,2,3,4,5))+
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0, 0))

ggsave(paste0("output/figures/LS FUBI30 RURO", ".png"),
       height = 16, width = 22.5, units = 'cm', dpi=330)
```

## 1.a Budget neutrality of reform
```{r}
if (check_budgetneutrality){
  em_b <- read.delim(paste0(inputfolder, "EM-output/be_2019_std.txt"), dec = ",")
  em_ba <- f_aggregate_expenditure(em_b)
  
  nbb_tva_2019 <- 32181300000
  bl_tva_2019 <- 12*sum(em_ba$tva_tot*em_ba$dwt)
  bl_tx_2019 <- 12*(sum(em_ba$txa_tot*em_ba$dwt)+sum(em_ba$txv_tot*em_ba$dwt))
  ratio_tva <- nbb_tva_2019/bl_tva_2019
  
  em_i1 <- read.delim(paste0(inputfolder, "EM-output/be_2019_i1_cq.txt"), dec = ",")
  em_i2 <- read.delim(paste0(inputfolder, "EM-output/be_2019_i2_cq.txt"), dec = ",")
  em_d1 <- read.delim(paste0(inputfolder, "EM-output/BE_2019_d1_cq.txt"), dec = ",")
  em_d2 <- read.delim(paste0(inputfolder, "EM-output/BE_2019_d2_cq.txt"), dec = ",")  
  em_i1a <- f_aggregate_expenditure(em_i1)
  em_i2a <- f_aggregate_expenditure(em_i2)
  em_d1a <- f_aggregate_expenditure(em_d1)
  em_d2a <- f_aggregate_expenditure(em_d2)
  
  rev_b <- 12*sum((ratio_tva * em_ba$tva_tot + em_ba$txv_tot + em_ba$txa_tot + em_ba$tin_s + em_ba$tscee_s - em_ba$tsceerd_s)*em_ba$dwt)
  rev_i1 <- 12*sum((ratio_tva * em_i1a$tva_tot + em_i1a$txv_tot + em_i1a$txa_tot + em_i1a$tin_s + em_i1a$tscee_s - em_i1a$tsceerd_s)*em_i1a$dwt)
  rev_i2 <- 12*sum((ratio_tva * em_i2a$tva_tot + em_i2a$txv_tot + em_i2a$txa_tot + em_i2a$tin_s + em_i2a$tscee_s - em_i2a$tsceerd_s)*em_i2a$dwt)
  rev_d1 <- 12*sum((ratio_tva * em_d1a$tva_tot + em_d1a$txv_tot + em_d1a$txa_tot + em_d1a$tin_s + em_d1a$tscee_s - em_d1a$tsceerd_s)*em_d1a$dwt)
  rev_d2 <- 12*sum((ratio_tva * em_d2a$tva_tot + em_d2a$txv_tot + em_d2a$txa_tot + em_d2a$tin_s + em_d2a$tscee_s - em_d2a$tsceerd_s)*em_d2a$dwt)

  
  rev_d1 <- 12*sum()
  
  budget_i1 <- 12*(sum(em_ba$tin_s*em_ba$dwt) - sum(em_r1a$tin_s*em_r1a$dwt))
  fin_i2 <- 12*ratio_tva*(sum(em_r2a$tva_tot*em_r2a$dwt) - sum(em_ba$tva_tot*em_ba$dwt))
  budget_r1/10^6
  fin_r2/10^6
  (budget_r1 - fin_r2)/10^6
  
  baseline <- em_ba %>% summarise(tva = sum(tva_tot*dwt), tin = sum(tin_s*dwt))
  reform1 <- em_r1a %>% summarise(tva = sum(tva_tot*dwt), tin = sum(tin_s*dwt))
  reform2 <- em_r2a %>% summarise(tva = sum(tva_tot*dwt), tin = sum(tin_s*dwt))
}

# budget neutral reform in first order, assuming no LS reaction and CQ and only 1/1.9 of VAT results captured by model:
# VAT rate of 6% and VAT rate of 12% increased to 21%
# An increase of the base allowance from €8 860 to €14 955, which is not enjoyed by non-workers, since the tax reduction for replacement incomes is reduced equivalently. 
```

```{r}
if (new_em_full){
  #everything on hh level
  IEMO <- paste0(inputfolder, "EM-output/")
  ISCS <- paste0(inputfolder, "EM-SILC-choicesets/")
  
  em_bl <- read.delim2(paste0(IEMO, "BE_2019_std_itt.txt"), dec = ",")
  em_bl <- em_bl %>% group_by(idhh) %>% mutate(
    hh_size = n(),
    children0_13 = sum(dag <= 13),
    eqincome = sum(ils_dispy)/(1 + 0.5*(hh_size - children0_13) + 0.3*children0_13) 
  ) %>% ungroup()
  quieqincome <- weighted_quantile(em_bl$eqincome, em_bl$dwt, seq(0,1, 0.2)) 
  saveRDS(quieqincome, paste0(outputfolder, "quieqincome.RDS"))
  
  em_bl <- em_bl %>% group_by(idhh) %>% mutate(dwt2 = sum(dwt), 
                                                       lhw_hh = sum(lhw), 
                                                       tscee_hh = sum(tscee_s - tsceerd_s), 
                                                       tscer_hh = sum(tscer_s),
                                                       tin_hh = sum(tin_s), 
                                                       ils_ben_hh = sum(ils_ben)) %>% ungroup()
```

## 2.2 merge data
```{r}
if(new_em_full){
  varlist_b <-c("dwt", "dwt2", "hh_head", "quieqinc")
  varlist_r <- c("dispy_hh", "lhw_hh", "tscee_hh", "tscer_hh", "tin_hh", "ils_ben_hh", "tva_tot", "txv_tot", "txa_tot", "indtax_tot", "dx_tot", "dpi")
  
  em_full <- left_join(em_bl %>% select(all_of(c("idhh", varlist_b, varlist_r))) %>% rename_at(vars(all_of(varlist_r)), ~ paste0(., "_bl")),
                       em_i1_cq %>% select(all_of(c("idhh", varlist_r))) %>% rename_at(vars(all_of(varlist_r)), ~ paste0(., "_i1_cq")), by = "idhh")
  em_full <- left_join(em_full, 
                       em_i1_cis %>% select(all_of(c("idhh", varlist_r))) %>% rename_at(vars(all_of(varlist_r)), ~ paste0(., "_i1_cis")), by = "idhh")
  em_full <- left_join(em_full, 
                       em_i2_cq %>% select(all_of(c("idhh", varlist_r))) %>% rename_at(vars(all_of(varlist_r)), ~ paste0(., "_i2_cq")), by = "idhh")
  em_full <- left_join(em_full, 
                       em_i2_cis %>% select(all_of(c("idhh", varlist_r))) %>% rename_at(vars(all_of(varlist_r)), ~ paste0(., "_i2_cis")), by = "idhh")
  em_full <- left_join(em_full, 
                       em_d1i1_cq %>% select(all_of(c("idhh", varlist_r))) %>% rename_at(vars(all_of(varlist_r)), ~ paste0(., "_d1i1_cq")), by = "idhh")
  em_full <- left_join(em_full, 
                       em_d1i1_cis %>% select(all_of(c("idhh", varlist_r))) %>% rename_at(vars(all_of(varlist_r)), ~ paste0(., "_d1i1_cis")), by = "idhh")
  em_full <- left_join(em_full, 
                       em_d2i1_cq %>% select(all_of(c("idhh", varlist_r))) %>% rename_at(vars(all_of(varlist_r)), ~ paste0(., "_d2i1_cq")), by = "idhh")
  em_full <- left_join(em_full, 
                       em_d2i1_cis %>% select(all_of(c("idhh", varlist_r))) %>% rename_at(vars(all_of(varlist_r)), ~ paste0(., "_d2i1_cis")), by = "idhh")
  em_full <- left_join(em_full, 
                       em_d1i2_cq %>% select(all_of(c("idhh", varlist_r))) %>% rename_at(vars(all_of(varlist_r)), ~ paste0(., "_d1i2_cq")), by = "idhh")
  em_full <- left_join(em_full, 
                       em_d1i2_cis %>% select(all_of(c("idhh", varlist_r))) %>% rename_at(vars(all_of(varlist_r)), ~ paste0(., "_d1i2_cis")), by = "idhh")
  em_full <- left_join(em_full, 
                       em_d2i2_cq %>% select(all_of(c("idhh", varlist_r))) %>% rename_at(vars(all_of(varlist_r)), ~ paste0(., "_d2i2_cq")), by = "idhh")
  em_full <- left_join(em_full, 
                       em_d2i2_cis %>% select(all_of(c("idhh", varlist_r))) %>% rename_at(vars(all_of(varlist_r)), ~ paste0(., "_d2i2_cis")), by = "idhh")
  
  em_full <- em_full %>% filter(dispy_hh_bl >=0)
  
  saveRDS(em_full, paste0(inputfolder, "EM-output/em_full.RDS"))
}
```

## 5.1 Load RURO data and prepare data
```{r}
if (new_pdata){
  IEMO <- paste0(inputfolder, "EM-output/")
  ISCS <- paste0(inputfolder, "EM-SILC-choicesets/")
  
  em_full_2019 <- read.delim2(paste0(IEMO, "BE_2019_std_itt.txt"), dec = ",")
  em_full_2019 <- em_full_2019 %>% group_by(idhh) %>% mutate(
    hh_size = n(),
    children0_13 = sum(dag <= 13),
    eqincome = sum(ils_dispy)/(1 + 0.5*(hh_size - children0_13) + 0.3*children0_13) 
  ) %>% ungroup()
  em_full_2019 <- f_dpi_basey(em_full_2019)
  em_full_2019 <- f_indirect_tax_rates(em_full_2019)
  
  em_full_2019_i1_cq <- read.delim2(paste0(IEMO, "BE_2019_i1_cq.txt"), dec = ",")
  em_full_2019_i1_cq <- f_indirect_tax_rates(em_full_2019_i1_cq)
  
  em_full_2019_i2_cq <- read.delim2(paste0(IEMO, "BE_2019_i2_cq.txt"), dec = ",")
  em_full_2019_i2_cq <- f_indirect_tax_rates(em_full_2019_i2_cq)
  
  em_full_2019_i1 <- read.delim2(paste0(IEMO, "BE_2019_i1_cis.txt"), dec = ",")
  em_full_2019_i1 <- em_full_2019_i1 %>% group_by(idhh) %>% mutate(
    hh_size = n(),
    children0_13 = sum(dag <= 13),
    eqincome = sum(ils_dispy)/(1 + 0.5*(hh_size - children0_13) + 0.3*children0_13) 
  ) %>% ungroup()
  em_full_2019_i1 <- f_dpi_basey(em_full_2019_i1)
  em_full_2019_i1 <- f_indirect_tax_rates(em_full_2019_i1)
  
  em_full_2019_i2 <- read.delim2(paste0(IEMO, "BE_2019_i2_cis.txt"), dec = ",")
  em_full_2019_i2 <- em_full_2019_i2 %>% group_by(idhh) %>% mutate(
    hh_size = n(),
    children0_13 = sum(dag <= 13),
    eqincome = sum(ils_dispy)/(1 + 0.5*(hh_size - children0_13) + 0.3*children0_13) 
  ) %>% ungroup()
  em_full_2019_i2 <- f_dpi_basey(em_full_2019_i2)
  em_full_2019_i2 <- f_indirect_tax_rates(em_full_2019_i2)

  
  #choice sets
  em_s_b <- read.delim2(paste0(IEMO, "be_2019_std_s.txt"), dec = ",")
  em_c_b <- read.delim2(paste0(IEMO, "be_2019_std_c.txt"), dec = ",")
  em_b <- rbind(em_s_b, em_c_b)
  em_b <- f_add_consvars(em_b, em_full_2019, em_full_2019)
  rm(em_s_b, em_c_b)
  
  em_i1 <- f_add_consvars(em_b, em_full_2019_i1, em_full_2019_i2)
  em_i2 <- f_add_consvars(em_b, em_full_2019_i2, em_full_2019_i2)
  
  em_s_d1 <- read.delim2(paste0(IEMO, "be_2019_d1_std_s.txt"), dec = ",")
  em_c_d1 <- read.delim2(paste0(IEMO, "be_2019_d1_std_c.txt"), dec = ",")
  em_d1 <- rbind(em_s_d1, em_c_d1)
  rm(em_s_d1, em_c_d1)
  
  em_d1i1 <- f_add_consvars(em_d1, em_full_2019_i1, em_full_2019_i1)
  em_d1i2 <- f_add_consvars(em_d1, em_full_2019_i2, em_full_2019_i2)
  
  em_s_d2 <- read.delim2(paste0(IEMO, "be_2019_d2_std_s.txt"), dec = ",")
  em_c_d2 <- read.delim2(paste0(IEMO, "be_2019_d2_Std_c.txt"), dec = ",")
  em_d2 <- rbind(em_s_d2, em_c_d2)
  rm(em_s_d2, em_c_d2)
  
  em_d2i1 <- f_add_consvars(em_d2, em_full_2019_i1, em_full_2019_i1)
  em_d2i2 <- f_add_consvars(em_d2, em_full_2019_i2, em_full_2019_i2)
  
  #changed labour demand
  em_s_b_dld <- read.delim2(paste0(IEMO, "be_2019_std_s_dld.txt"), dec = ",")
  em_c_b_dld <- read.delim2(paste0(IEMO, "be_2019_std_c_dld.txt"), dec = ",")
  em_b_dld <- rbind(em_s_b_dld, em_c_b_dld)
  em_b_dld <- f_add_consvars(em_b_dld, em_full_2019, em_full_2019)
  rm(em_s_b_dld, em_c_b_dld)
  
  em_s_d1_dld <- read.delim2(paste0(IEMO, "be_2019_d1_std_s_dld.txt"), dec = ",")
  em_c_d1_dld <- read.delim2(paste0(IEMO, "be_2019_d1_std_c_dld.txt"), dec = ",")
  em_d1_dld <- rbind(em_s_d1_dld, em_c_d1_dld)
  rm(em_s_d1_dld, em_c_d1_dld)
  
  em_d1i1_dld <- f_add_consvars(em_d1_dld, em_full_2019_i1, em_full_2019_i1)
  em_d1i2_dld <- f_add_consvars(em_d1_dld, em_full_2019_i2, em_full_2019_i2)
  
  em_s_d2_dld <- read.delim2(paste0(IEMO, "be_2019_d2_std_s_dld.txt"), dec = ",")
  em_c_d2_dld <- read.delim2(paste0(IEMO, "be_2019_d2_std_c_dld.txt"), dec = ",")
  em_d2_dld <- rbind(em_s_d2_dld, em_c_d2_dld)
  rm(em_s_d2_dld, em_c_d2_dld)
  
  em_d2i1_dld <- f_add_consvars(em_d2_dld, em_full_2019_i1, em_full_2019_i1)
  em_d2i2_dld <- f_add_consvars(em_d2_dld, em_full_2019_i2, em_full_2019_i2)
  
  #samenvoegen tot samp
  aux_b <- read.delim2(paste0(ISCS, "aux_2019_wri_sim.txt"), dec = ".")
  aux_b_dld <- read.delim2(paste0(ISCS, "aux_2019_wri_sim_dld.txt"), dec = ".")
  
  samp_b <- left_join(em_b, aux_b, by = "idperson")
  samp_b <- samp_b %>% mutate(dwt = round(dwt, digits = 4))
  
  samp_i1 <- left_join(em_i1, aux_b, by = "idperson")
  samp_i1 <- samp_i1 %>% mutate(dwt = round(dwt, digits = 4))
  samp_i2 <- left_join(em_i2, aux_b, by = "idperson")
  samp_i2 <- samp_i2 %>% mutate(dwt = round(dwt, digits = 4))
  samp_d1i1 <- left_join(em_d1i1, aux_b, by = "idperson")
  samp_d1i1 <- samp_d1i1 %>% mutate(dwt = round(dwt, digits = 4))
  samp_d1i2 <- left_join(em_d1i2, aux_b, by = "idperson")
  samp_d1i2 <- samp_d1i2 %>% mutate(dwt = round(dwt, digits = 4))
  samp_d2i1 <- left_join(em_d2i1, aux_b, by = "idperson")
  samp_d2i1 <- samp_d2i1 %>% mutate(dwt = round(dwt, digits = 4))
  samp_d2i2 <- left_join(em_d2i2, aux_b, by = "idperson")
  samp_d2i2 <- samp_d2i2 %>% mutate(dwt = round(dwt, digits = 4))
  rm(em_b, em_i1, em_i2, em_d1i1, em_d1i2, em_d2i1, em_d2i2, aux_b)
  
  samp_b_dld <- left_join(em_b_dld, aux_b_dld, by = "idperson")
  samp_b_dld <- samp_b_dld %>% mutate(dwt = round(dwt, digits = 4))
  
  samp_d1i1_dld <- left_join(em_d1i1_dld, aux_b_dld, by = "idperson")
  samp_d1i1_dld <- samp_d1i1_dld %>% mutate(dwt = round(dwt, digits = 4))
  samp_d1i2_dld <- left_join(em_d1i2_dld, aux_b_dld, by = "idperson")
  samp_d1i2_dld <- samp_d1i2_dld %>% mutate(dwt = round(dwt, digits = 4))
  samp_d2i1_dld <- left_join(em_d2i1_dld, aux_b_dld, by = "idperson")
  samp_d2i1_dld <- samp_d2i1_dld %>% mutate(dwt = round(dwt, digits = 4))
  samp_d2i2_dld <- left_join(em_d2i2_dld, aux_b_dld, by = "idperson")
  samp_d2i2_dld <- samp_d2i2_dld %>% mutate(dwt = round(dwt, digits = 4))
  rm(em_d1_dld, em_d1i1_dld, em_d1i2_dld, em_d2_dld, em_d2i1_dld, em_d2i2_dld)
  
  pdata_b <- f_preparedata_sim(samp_b, "vw", gsurtab_long, mw_CPI_tab, wri = TRUE)
  saveRDS(pdata_b, file = paste0(inputfolder, "EM-SILC-choicesets/pdata_b.RDS"))
  pdata_i1 <- f_preparedata_sim(samp_i1, "vw", gsurtab_long, mw_CPI_tab, wri = TRUE)
  saveRDS(pdata_i1, file = paste0(inputfolder, "EM-SILC-choicesets/pdata_i1.RDS"))
  pdata_i2 <- f_preparedata_sim(samp_i2, "vw", gsurtab_long, mw_CPI_tab, wri = TRUE)
  saveRDS(pdata_i2, file = paste0(inputfolder, "EM-SILC-choicesets/pdata_i2.RDS"))
  pdata_d1i1 <- f_preparedata_sim(samp_d1i1, "vw", gsurtab_long, mw_CPI_tab, wri = TRUE)
  saveRDS(pdata_d1i1, file = paste0(inputfolder, "EM-SILC-choicesets/pdata_d1i1.RDS"))
  pdata_d1i2 <- f_preparedata_sim(samp_d1i2, "vw", gsurtab_long, mw_CPI_tab, wri = TRUE)
  saveRDS(pdata_d1i2, file = paste0(inputfolder, "EM-SILC-choicesets/pdata_d1i2.RDS"))
  pdata_d2i1 <- f_preparedata_sim(samp_d2i1, "vw", gsurtab_long, mw_CPI_tab, wri = TRUE)
  saveRDS(pdata_d2i1, file = paste0(inputfolder, "EM-SILC-choicesets/pdata_d2i1.RDS"))
  pdata_d2i2 <- f_preparedata_sim(samp_d2i2, "vw", gsurtab_long, mw_CPI_tab, wri = TRUE)
  saveRDS(pdata_d2i2, file = paste0(inputfolder, "EM-SILC-choicesets/pdata_d2i2.RDS"))
```

### 5.1.b spread price indices
```{r}
if (new_pdata){
  pi <- matrix(0, nrow = 3, ncol = 9)
  rownames(pi) <- c("sm", "sf", "cou")
  colnames(pi) <- c("mean", "sd", "min", "p10", "p25", "p50", "p75", "p90", "max")
  pi_bl <- pi_i1 <- pi_i2 <- pi
  for (t in c("sm", "sf", "cou")){
    if (t == "sm"){
      df <- pdata_b$sm
    } else if (t == "sf"){
      df <- pdata_b$sf
    } else if (t == "cou"){
      df <- pdata_b$cou %>% mutate(dpi = dpi_m)
    }
    df_sum <- df %>% filter(draw == 0) %>% summarise(
      mean = weighted.mean(dpi, dwt),
      sd = sqrt(wtd.var(dpi, dwt)),
      min = min(dpi),
      p10 = weighted_quantile(dpi, dwt, 0.10),
      p25 = weighted_quantile(dpi, dwt, 0.25),
      p50 = weighted_quantile(dpi, dwt, 0.5),
      p75 = weighted_quantile(dpi, dwt, 0.75),
      p90 = weighted_quantile(dpi, dwt, 0.9),
      max = max(dpi)
    )
    pi_bl[t,] <- t(df_sum)
  }
  write.csv2(pi_bl, paste0(outputfolder, "spread_dpi_bl.csv"), row.names = T)
  for (t in c("sm", "sf", "cou")){
    if (t == "sm"){
      df <- pdata_i1$sm
    } else if (t == "sf"){
      df <- pdata_i1$sf
    } else if (t == "cou"){
      df <- pdata_i1$cou %>% mutate(dpi = dpi_m)
    }
    df_sum <- df %>% filter(draw == 0) %>% summarise(
      mean = weighted.mean(dpi, dwt),
      sd = sqrt(wtd.var(dpi, dwt)),
      min = min(dpi),
      p10 = weighted_quantile(dpi, dwt, 0.10),
      p25 = weighted_quantile(dpi, dwt, 0.25),
      p50 = weighted_quantile(dpi, dwt, 0.5),
      p75 = weighted_quantile(dpi, dwt, 0.75),
      p90 = weighted_quantile(dpi, dwt, 0.9),
      max = max(dpi)
    )
    pi_i1[t,] <- t(df_sum)
  }
  write.csv2(pi_i1, paste0(outputfolder, "spread_dpi_re_i1.csv"), row.names = T)
  for (t in c("sm", "sf", "cou")){
    if (t == "sm"){
      df <- pdata_i2$sm
    } else if (t == "sf"){
      df <- pdata_i2$sf
    } else if (t == "cou"){
      df <- pdata_i2$cou %>% mutate(dpi = dpi_m)
    }
    df_sum <- df %>% filter(draw == 0) %>% summarise(
      mean = weighted.mean(dpi, dwt),
      sd = sqrt(wtd.var(dpi, dwt)),
      min = min(dpi),
      p10 = weighted_quantile(dpi, dwt, 0.10),
      p25 = weighted_quantile(dpi, dwt, 0.25),
      p50 = weighted_quantile(dpi, dwt, 0.5),
      p75 = weighted_quantile(dpi, dwt, 0.75),
      p90 = weighted_quantile(dpi, dwt, 0.9),
      max = max(dpi)
    )
    pi_i2[t,] <- t(df_sum)
  }
  write.csv2(pi_i2, paste0(outputfolder, "spread_dpi_re_i2.csv"), row.names = T)
}
```

```{r}
ff_predchoice6 <- function(df_b, df_r1, df_r2, df_r3, df_r4, df_r5, df_r6){
  df_b <- ff_gumbel_draw(df_b, uncond = FALSE)
  df_r1 <- df_r1 %>% mutate(
    gumb_draw = df_b$gumb_draw[match(idhh, df_b$idhh)],
    util_tot = util + gumb_draw
  )
  id_pc1 <- df_r1 %>% group_by(idhh_true) %>% slice(which.max(util_tot)) %>% pull(idhh)
  df_r1 <- df_r1 %>% mutate(pred_choice = ifelse(idhh %in% id_pc1, 1, 0))
  rm(id_pc1)
  df_r2 <- df_r2 %>% mutate(
    gumb_draw = df_b$gumb_draw[match(idhh, df_b$idhh)],
    util_tot = util + gumb_draw
  )
  id_pc2 <- df_r2 %>% group_by(idhh_true) %>% slice(which.max(util_tot)) %>% pull(idhh)
  df_r2 <- df_r2 %>% mutate(pred_choice = ifelse(idhh %in% id_pc2, 1, 0))
  rm(id_pc2)
  df_r3 <- df_r3 %>% mutate(
    gumb_draw = df_b$gumb_draw[match(idhh, df_b$idhh)], 
    util_tot = util + gumb_draw
  )
  id_pc3 <- df_r3 %>% group_by(idhh_true) %>% slice(which.max(util_tot)) %>% pull(idhh)
  df_r3 <- df_r3 %>% mutate(pred_choice = ifelse(idhh %in% id_pc3, 1, 0))
  rm(id_pc3)
  df_r4 <- df_r4 %>% mutate(
    gumb_draw = df_b$gumb_draw[match(idhh, df_b$idhh)], 
    util_tot = util + gumb_draw
  )
  id_pc4 <- df_r4 %>% group_by(idhh_true) %>% slice(which.max(util_tot)) %>% pull(idhh)
  df_r4 <- df_r4 %>% mutate(pred_choice = ifelse(idhh %in% id_pc4, 1, 0))
  rm(id_pc4)
  df_r5 <- df_r5 %>% mutate(
    gumb_draw = df_b$gumb_draw[match(idhh, df_b$idhh)], 
    util_tot = util + gumb_draw
  )
  id_pc5 <- df_r5 %>% group_by(idhh_true) %>% slice(which.max(util_tot)) %>% pull(idhh)
  df_r5 <- df_r5 %>% mutate(pred_choice = ifelse(idhh %in% id_pc5, 1, 0))
  rm(id_pc5)
  df_r6 <- df_r6 %>% mutate(
    gumb_draw = df_b$gumb_draw[match(idhh, df_b$idhh)], 
    util_tot = util + gumb_draw
  )
  id_pc6 <- df_r6 %>% group_by(idhh_true) %>% slice(which.max(util_tot)) %>% pull(idhh)
  df_r6 <- df_r6 %>% mutate(pred_choice = ifelse(idhh %in% id_pc6, 1, 0))
  rm(id_pc6)
  return(list("df_b"= df_b, "df_r1"= df_r1, "df_r2"=df_r2, "df_r3"=df_r3, "df_r4"=df_r4, "df_r5"=df_r5, "df_r6"=df_r6))
}
f_em_merge6 <- function(em_r1, em_r2, em_r3, em_r4, em_r5, em_r6, varlist_b, varlist_b_com, varlist_r, varlist_r_com){
  varlist_b_s <- paste0(c(varlist_b_com, varlist_b),".obs")
  varlist_b_c <- paste0(c(varlist_b_com, paste0(varlist_b, "_m"), paste0(varlist_b, "_f")), ".obs")
  varlist_r_s <- c(paste0(c(varlist_r_com, varlist_r), ".for"),paste0(c(varlist_r_com, varlist_r), ".exp"))
  varlist_r_c <- c(paste0(c(varlist_r_com, paste0(varlist_r, "_m"), paste0(varlist_r, "_f")), ".for"), paste0(c(varlist_r_com, paste0(varlist_r, "_m"), paste0(varlist_r, "_f")), ".exp"))
  
  for (i in c("sm", "sf", "coum", "couf")){
    print(i)
    if(i == "sm"){
      df1 = em_r1$sm
      df2 = em_r2$sm
      df3 = em_r3$sm
      df4 = em_r4$sm
      df5 = em_r5$sm
      df6 = em_r6$sm
      varlist_b <- varlist_b_s
      varlist_r <- varlist_r_s
    } else if (i == "sf"){
      df1 = em_r1$sf
      df2 = em_r2$sf
      df3 = em_r3$sf
      df4 = em_r4$sf
      df5 = em_r5$sf
      df6 = em_r6$sf
      varlist_b <- varlist_b_s
      varlist_r <- varlist_r_s
    } else if (i == "coum"|i == "couf"){
      df1 = em_r1$cou
      df2 = em_r2$cou
      df3 = em_r3$cou
      df4 = em_r4$cou
      df5 = em_r5$cou
      df6 = em_r6$cou
      varlist_b <- varlist_b_c
      varlist_r <- varlist_r_c
    } 
    df_all <- left_join(df1 %>% select(idhh_true, all_of(varlist_b)), 
                        df1 %>% select(idhh_true, all_of(varlist_r)) %>% rename_at(vars(all_of(varlist_r)), ~ str_c(., "_r1")), by = "idhh_true")
    df_all <- left_join(df_all, df2 %>% select(idhh_true, all_of(varlist_r)) %>% rename_at(vars(all_of(varlist_r)), ~ str_c(., "_r2")), by = "idhh_true")
    df_all <- left_join(df_all, df3 %>% select(idhh_true, all_of(varlist_r)) %>% rename_at(vars(all_of(varlist_r)), ~ str_c(., "_r3")), by = "idhh_true")
    df_all <- left_join(df_all, df4 %>% select(idhh_true, all_of(varlist_r)) %>% rename_at(vars(all_of(varlist_r)), ~ str_c(., "_r4")), by = "idhh_true")
    df_all <- left_join(df_all, df5 %>% select(idhh_true, all_of(varlist_r)) %>% rename_at(vars(all_of(varlist_r)), ~ str_c(., "_r5")), by = "idhh_true")
    df_all <- left_join(df_all, df6 %>% select(idhh_true, all_of(varlist_r)) %>% rename_at(vars(all_of(varlist_r)), ~ str_c(., "_r6")), by = "idhh_true")
    df_all <- df_all %>% mutate(group = i)
    if (i == "coum"){df_all <- df_all %>% select(-contains("_f")) %>% rename_at(vars(contains("_m")), ~ str_remove(., "_m"))}
    if (i == "couf"){df_all <- df_all %>% select(-contains("_m")) %>% rename_at(vars(contains("_f")), ~ str_remove(., "_f"))}
    if (i == "sm"){sm_all <- df_all} else if (i == "sf"){sf_all <- df_all} else if (i == "coum"){coum_all <- df_all}else if (i == "couf"){couf_all <- df_all}
  }
  em_all <- rbind(sm_all, sf_all, coum_all, couf_all)
  return(em_all)
}
```

```{r}
    sm_r3 <- sm_r3 %>% mutate(exp = pred_choice1)
    sm_r4 <- sm_r4 %>% mutate(exp = pred_choice1)
    sm_r5 <- sm_r5 %>% mutate(exp = pred_choice1)
    sf_r1 <- sf_r1 %>% mutate(exp = pred_choice1) 
    sf_r2 <- sf_r2 %>% mutate(exp = pred_choice1)
    sf_r3 <- sf_r3 %>% mutate(exp = pred_choice1)
    sf_r4 <- sf_r4 %>% mutate(exp = pred_choice1)
    sf_r5 <- sf_r5 %>% mutate(exp = pred_choice1)
    cou_r1 <- cou_r1 %>% mutate(exp = pred_choice1)
    cou_r2 <- cou_r2 %>% mutate(exp = pred_choice1)
    cou_r3 <- cou_r3 %>% mutate(exp = pred_choice1)
    cou_r4 <- cou_r4 %>% mutate(exp = pred_choice1)
    cou_r5 <- cou_r5 %>% mutate(exp = pred_choice1)
  }
  return(list("sm_b"=sm_b, "sf_b"=sf_b, "cou_b"=cou_b, "sm_r1"=sm_r1, "sf_r1"=sf_r1, "cou_r1"=cou_r1, "sm_r2"=sm_r2, "sf_r2"=sf_r2, "cou_r2"=cou_r2, "sm_r3"=sm_r3, "sf_r3"=sf_r3, "cou_r3"=cou_r3, "sm_r4"=sm_r4, "sf_r4"=sf_r4, "cou_r4"=cou_r4, "sm_r5"=sm_r5, "sf_r5"=sf_r5, "cou_r5"=cou_r5))
} 

ff_predchoice5 <- function(df_b, df_r1, df_r2, df_r3, df_r4, df_r5){
  df_b <- ff_gumbel_draw(df_b, uncond = FALSE)
  df_r1 <- df_r1 %>% mutate(
    gumb_draw = df_b$gumb_draw[match(idhh, df_b$idhh)],
    util_tot = util + gumb_draw
  )
  id_pc1 <- df_r1 %>% group_by(idhh_true) %>% slice(which.max(util_tot)) %>% pull(idhh)
  df_r1 <- df_r1 %>% mutate(pred_choice = ifelse(idhh %in% id_pc1, 1, 0))
  rm(id_pc1)
  df_r2 <- df_r2 %>% mutate(
    gumb_draw = df_b$gumb_draw[match(idhh, df_b$idhh)],
    util_tot = util + gumb_draw
  )
  id_pc2 <- df_r2 %>% group_by(idhh_true) %>% slice(which.max(util_tot)) %>% pull(idhh)
  df_r2 <- df_r2 %>% mutate(pred_choice = ifelse(idhh %in% id_pc2, 1, 0))
  rm(id_pc2)
  df_r3 <- df_r3 %>% mutate(
    gumb_draw = df_b$gumb_draw[match(idhh, df_b$idhh)], 
    util_tot = util + gumb_draw
  )
  id_pc3 <- df_r3 %>% group_by(idhh_true) %>% slice(which.max(util_tot)) %>% pull(idhh)
  df_r3 <- df_r3 %>% mutate(pred_choice = ifelse(idhh %in% id_pc3, 1, 0))
  rm(id_pc3)
  df_r4 <- df_r4 %>% mutate(
    gumb_draw = df_b$gumb_draw[match(idhh, df_b$idhh)], 
    util_tot = util + gumb_draw
  )
  id_pc4 <- df_r4 %>% group_by(idhh_true) %>% slice(which.max(util_tot)) %>% pull(idhh)
  df_r4 <- df_r4 %>% mutate(pred_choice = ifelse(idhh %in% id_pc4, 1, 0))
  rm(id_pc4)
  df_r5 <- df_r5 %>% mutate(
    gumb_draw = df_b$gumb_draw[match(idhh, df_b$idhh)], 
    util_tot = util + gumb_draw
  )
  id_pc5 <- df_r5 %>% group_by(idhh_true) %>% slice(which.max(util_tot)) %>% pull(idhh)
  df_r5 <- df_r5 %>% mutate(pred_choice = ifelse(idhh %in% id_pc5, 1, 0))
  rm(id_pc5)
  return(list("df_b"= df_b, "df_r1"= df_r1, "df_r2"=df_r2, "df_r3"=df_r3, "df_r4"=df_r4, "df_r5"=df_r5))
}
f_em_merge5 <- function(em_r1, em_r2, em_r3, em_r4, em_r5, varlist_b, varlist_b_com, varlist_r, varlist_r_com){
  varlist_b_s <- paste0(c(varlist_b_com, varlist_b),".obs")
  varlist_b_c <- paste0(c(varlist_b_com, paste0(varlist_b, "_m"), paste0(varlist_b, "_f")), ".obs")
  varlist_r_s <- c(paste0(c(varlist_r_com, varlist_r), ".for"),paste0(c(varlist_r_com, varlist_r), ".exp"))
  varlist_r_c <- c(paste0(c(varlist_r_com, paste0(varlist_r, "_m"), paste0(varlist_r, "_f")), ".for"), paste0(c(varlist_r_com, paste0(varlist_r, "_m"), paste0(varlist_r, "_f")), ".exp"))
  
  for (i in c("sm", "sf", "coum", "couf")){
    print(i)
    if(i == "sm"){
      df1 = em_r1$sm
      df2 = em_r2$sm
      df3 = em_r3$sm
      df4 = em_r4$sm
      df5 = em_r5$sm
      varlist_b <- varlist_b_s
      varlist_r <- varlist_r_s
    } else if (i == "sf"){
      df1 = em_r1$sf
      df2 = em_r2$sf
      df3 = em_r3$sf
      df4 = em_r4$sf
      df5 = em_r5$sf
      varlist_b <- varlist_b_s
      varlist_r <- varlist_r_s
    } else if (i == "coum"|i == "couf"){
      df1 = em_r1$cou
      df2 = em_r2$cou
      df3 = em_r3$cou
      df4 = em_r4$cou
      df5 = em_r5$cou
      varlist_b <- varlist_b_c
      varlist_r <- varlist_r_c
    } 
    df_all <- left_join(df1 %>% select(idhh_true, all_of(varlist_b)), 
                        df1 %>% select(idhh_true, all_of(varlist_r)) %>% rename_at(vars(all_of(varlist_r)), ~ str_c(., "_r1")), by = "idhh_true")
    df_all <- left_join(df_all, df2 %>% select(idhh_true, all_of(varlist_r)) %>% rename_at(vars(all_of(varlist_r)), ~ str_c(., "_r2")), by = "idhh_true")
    df_all <- left_join(df_all, df3 %>% select(idhh_true, all_of(varlist_r)) %>% rename_at(vars(all_of(varlist_r)), ~ str_c(., "_r3")), by = "idhh_true")
    df_all <- left_join(df_all, df4 %>% select(idhh_true, all_of(varlist_r)) %>% rename_at(vars(all_of(varlist_r)), ~ str_c(., "_r4")), by = "idhh_true")
    df_all <- left_join(df_all, df5 %>% select(idhh_true, all_of(varlist_r)) %>% rename_at(vars(all_of(varlist_r)), ~ str_c(., "_r5")), by = "idhh_true")
    df_all <- df_all %>% mutate(group = i)
    if (i == "coum"){df_all <- df_all %>% select(-contains("_f")) %>% rename_at(vars(contains("_m")), ~ str_remove(., "_m"))}
    if (i == "couf"){df_all <- df_all %>% select(-contains("_m")) %>% rename_at(vars(contains("_f")), ~ str_remove(., "_f"))}
    if (i == "sm"){sm_all <- df_all} else if (i == "sf"){sf_all <- df_all} else if (i == "coum"){coum_all <- df_all}else if (i == "couf"){couf_all <- df_all}
  }
  em_all <- rbind(sm_all, sf_all, coum_all, couf_all)
  return(em_all)
}

f_em_merge3 <- function(em_r1, em_r2, em_r3, varlist_b, varlist_b_com, varlist_r, varlist_r_com){
  varlist_b_s <- paste0(c(varlist_b_com, varlist_b),".obs")

  for (i in c("sm", "sf", "coum", "couf")){
    print(i)

      df1 = em_r1$sm

      varlist_b <- varlist_b_c

    df_all <- left_join(df1 %>% select(idhh_true, all_of(varlist_b)), 
                        df1 %>% select(idhh_true, all_of(varlist_r)) %>% rename_at(vars(all_of(varlist_r)), ~ str_c(., "_r1")), by = "idhh_true")
    df_all <- left_join(df_all, df2 %>% select(idhh_true, all_of(varlist_r)) %>% rename_at(vars(all_of(varlist_r)), ~ str_c(., "_r2")), by = "idhh_true")
    df_all <- left_join(df_all, df3 %>% select(idhh_true, all_of(varlist_r)) %>% rename_at(vars(all_of(varlist_r)), ~ str_c(., "_r3")), by = "idhh_true")
    df_all <- df_all %>% mutate(group = i)
    if (i == "coum"){df_all <- df_all %>% select(-contains("_f")) %>% rename_at(vars(contains("_m")), ~ str_remove(., "_m"))}
    if (i == "couf"){df_all <- df_all %>% select(-contains("_m")) %>% rename_at(vars(contains("_f")), ~ str_remove(., "_f"))}
    if (i == "sm"){sm_all <- df_all} else if (i == "sf"){sf_all <- df_all} else if (i == "coum"){coum_all <- df_all}else if (i == "couf"){couf_all <- df_all}
  }
  em_all <- rbind(sm_all, sf_all, coum_all, couf_all)
  return(em_all)
}
```

```{r}
if (new_em_ruro){

  varlist_r_com <- c()

  em_ruro <- f_em_merge6(em_r1, em_r2, em_r3, em_r4, em_r5, em_r6, varlist_b, varlist_b_com, varlist_r, varlist_r_com)

  qui_mwd <- weighted_quantile(em_ruro %>% mutate(mwd = exp(lw.obs+(sdw.obs^2)/2)) %>% pull(mwd), em_ruro$dwt.obs, seq(0,1, 0.2))
  
  em_ruro <- em_ruro %>% mutate(quieqinc = case_when(eqincome.obs<=quieqincome[2] ~ 1,

  )
  
  em_ruro <- em_ruro %>% filter(dispy_hh.obs >= 0)

    tscee_s.exp_r3 = tscee_s.exp_r3 - tsceerd_s.exp_r3, 
    tscee_s.exp_r4 = tscee_s.exp_r4 - tsceerd_s.exp_r4, 
    tscee_s.exp_r5 = tscee_s.exp_r5 - tsceerd_s.exp_r5, 
    tscee_s.exp_r6 = tscee_s.exp_r6 - tsceerd_s.exp_r6
  )
  
  saveRDS(em_ruro, paste0(inputfolder, "em_ruro.RDS"))
}
```

```{r}
                                                           eqincome.obs<=quieqincome[4] ~ 3,
                                                           eqincome.obs<=quieqincome[5] ~ 4,
                                                           eqincome.obs<=quieqincome[6] ~ 5),
                                      mwd = exp(lw.obs+(sdw.obs^2)/2),
                                      quimwd = case_when(mwd<=qui_mwd[2] ~ 1,
                                                         mwd<=qui_mwd[3] ~ 2,
                                                         mwd<=qui_mwd[4] ~ 3,
                                                         mwd<=qui_mwd[5] ~ 4,
                                                         mwd<=qui_mwd[6] ~ 5),
                                      quiwag = case_when(yivwg<=qui_wag[2] ~ 1,
                                                         yivwg<=qui_wag[3] ~ 2,
                                                         yivwg<=qui_wag[4] ~ 3,
                                                         yivwg<=qui_wag[5] ~ 4,
                                                         yivwg<=qui_wag[6] ~ 5)
  )
  
  
  em_ruro_d1 <- em_ruro_d1 %>% filter(dispy_hh.obs >= 0)
  em_ruro_d2 <- em_ruro_d2 %>% filter(dispy_hh.obs >= 0)
  
  em_ruro_d1 <- em_ruro_d1 %>% mutate(BS = ifelse(group %in% c("sm", "sf"), "single", "couple"),
                                      GE = ifelse(group %in% c("sm", "coum"), "male", "female"))
  
  em_ruro_d2 <- em_ruro_d2 %>% mutate(BS = ifelse(group %in% c("sm", "sf"), "single", "couple"),
                                      GE = ifelse(group %in% c("sm", "coum"), "male", "female"))
  
  em_ruro_d1 <- em_ruro_d1 %>% mutate(
    tscee_s.obs = tscee_s.obs - tsceerd_s.obs, 
    tscee_s.for_r1 = tscee_s.for_r1 - tsceerd_s.for_r1, 
    tscee_s.for_r2 = tscee_s.for_r2 - tsceerd_s.for_r2, 
    tscee_s.exp_r1 = tscee_s.exp_r1 - tsceerd_s.exp_r1, 
    tscee_s.exp_r2 = tscee_s.exp_r2 - tsceerd_s.exp_r2, 
  )
  em_ruro_d2 <- em_ruro_d2 %>% mutate(
    tscee_s.obs = tscee_s.obs - tsceerd_s.obs, 
    tscee_s.for_r1 = tscee_s.for_r1 - tsceerd_s.for_r1, 
    tscee_s.for_r2 = tscee_s.for_r2 - tsceerd_s.for_r2, 
    tscee_s.exp_r1 = tscee_s.exp_r1 - tsceerd_s.exp_r1, 
    tscee_s.exp_r2 = tscee_s.exp_r2 - tsceerd_s.exp_r2, 
  )
  
  saveRDS(em_ruro_d1, paste0(inputfolder, "em_ruro_d1.RDS"))
  saveRDS(em_ruro_d2, paste0(inputfolder, "em_ruro_d2.RDS"))
}

```

```{r}
  difh_im_r2 = ifelse(working.obs == 1 & working.exp_r2 != 0, (hours.exp_r2/working.exp_r2 - hours.obs)*working.exp_r2, 0),
  difh_im_r3 = ifelse(working.obs == 1 & working.exp_r3 != 0, (hours.exp_r3/working.exp_r3 - hours.obs)*working.exp_r3, 0),
  difh_im_r4 = ifelse(working.obs == 1 & working.exp_r4 != 0, (hours.exp_r4/working.exp_r4 - hours.obs)*working.exp_r4, 0),
  difh_im_r5 = ifelse(working.obs == 1 & working.exp_r5 != 0, (hours.exp_r5/working.exp_r5 - hours.obs)*working.exp_r5, 0),
  difh_im_r6 = ifelse(working.obs == 1 & working.exp_r6 != 0, (hours.exp_r6/working.exp_r6 - hours.obs)*working.exp_r6, 0),
  
  difh_em_r1 = ifelse(working.obs == 0, hours.exp_r1, 0) - ifelse(working.obs == 1, hours.obs * (1 - working.exp_r1), 0),
```

```{r reform i1 - hours by equinc}
ggplot(data = df_fig5_quieqinc %>% filter(scenario == 1)) +
  labs(title = "carbon tax", 
       subtitle = "mean change in hours worked", 
       caption = "Source: Department of Economics - KU Leuven; Simulations with Euromod, SILC and HBS", 
       x = "quintiles equiv. disp. inc.",
       y = ""
  ) + 
  theme_1 +
  theme(legend.position = "right", legend.title = element_blank()) + 
  geom_hline(aes(yintercept = 0)) + 
  facet_grid(GE ~ BS) + 
  geom_col(data = df_fig5_quieqinc %>% filter(marge != "totaal", scenario == 1), 
           aes(quieqinc, dif, fill = marge), 
           alpha = 1,
           position = "stack"
  ) +
  geom_point(data = df_fig5_quieqinc %>% filter(marge == "totaal", scenario == 1), 
             aes(quieqinc, dif), 
             alpha = 1,
             col = "black",
             fill = "black"
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = colors_marge) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, 6)) +
  scale_x_continuous(expand = c(0, 0),
                     breaks = c(1,2,3,4,5),
                     labels = c(1,2,3,4,5))+
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0, 0))

ggsave(paste0("output/figures/uren quieqinc - EMLS - i1", ".png"),
       height = 16, width = 22.5, units = 'cm', dpi=330)

```

# isolated impacts (only total labor supply effect)
```{r}
df_fig7_quiwage <- df_tab_between %>% group_by(BS, GE, quiwag) %>% summarise(
      dif_tot_r1 = sum(difh_r1*dwt.obs)/sum(dwt.obs), 
      dif_tot_r3r1 = sum(difh_r3r1*dwt.obs)/sum(dwt.obs), 
      dif_tot_r5r3 = sum(difh_r5r3*dwt.obs)/sum(dwt.obs),
      dif_tot_r5r0 = sum(difh_r5 * dwt.obs)/sum(dwt.obs),
      dif_tot_r3r0 = sum(difh_r3 * dwt.obs)/sum(dwt.obs)
) %>% pivot_longer(
   cols = starts_with("dif"),
   names_to = "marge",
   names_prefix = "dif_",
   values_to = "dif",
   values_drop_na = TRUE
 ) %>% mutate(scenario = case_when(str_detect(marge, "_r1") ~   "r1", 
                                   str_detect(marge, "_r3r1") ~ "r3r1",
                                   str_detect(marge, "_r5r3") ~ "r5r3",
                                   str_detect(marge, "_r5r0") ~ "r5r0",
                                   str_detect(marge, "_r3r0") ~ "r3r0"),
              scenario = factor(scenario, levels = c("r3r0", "r5r0", "r5r3", "r3r1", "r1"),
                                labels = c("LS impact", "overall impact", "LD effect", "Rev. rec.", "Carbon tax"))
 ) %>% mutate(marge = str_replace(marge, "_r1", ""), 
              marge = str_replace(marge, "_r2r1", ""),
              marge = str_replace(marge, "_r3r1", ""),
              marge = str_replace(marge, "_r4r2", ""), 
              marge = str_replace(marge, "_r5r3", ""),
              marge = str_replace(marge, "_r5r0", ""),
              marge = str_replace(marge, "_r3r0", ""),
              marge = factor(marge, levels = c("tot"), 
                             labels = c("totaal")))

df_fig8_quiwage <- df_tab_between %>% group_by(BS, GE, quiwag) %>% summarise(
      dif_tot_r1 = sum(dify_r1*dwt.obs)/sum(dwt.obs), 
      dif_tot_r3r1 = sum(dify_r3r1*dwt.obs)/sum(dwt.obs), 
      dif_tot_r5r3 = sum(dify_r5r3*dwt.obs)/sum(dwt.obs),
      dif_tot_r5r0 = sum(dify_r5 * dwt.obs)/sum(dwt.obs),
      dif_tot_r3r0 = sum(dify_r3 * dwt.obs)/sum(dwt.obs)
) %>% pivot_longer(
   cols = starts_with("dif"),
   names_to = "marge",
   names_prefix = "dif_",
   values_to = "dif",
   values_drop_na = TRUE
 ) %>% mutate(scenario = case_when(str_detect(marge, "_r1") ~   "r1", 
                                   str_detect(marge, "_r3r1") ~ "r3r1",
                                   str_detect(marge, "_r5r3") ~ "r5r3",
                                   str_detect(marge, "_r5r0") ~ "r5r0",
                                   str_detect(marge, "_r3r0") ~ "r3r0"), 
              scenario = factor(scenario, levels = c("r3r0", "r5r0", "r5r3", "r3r1", "r1"), 
                                labels = c("LS impact", "overall impact", "LD effect", "Rev. rec.", "Carbon tax"))
 ) %>% mutate(marge = str_replace(marge, "_r1", ""), 
              marge = str_replace(marge, "_r2r1", ""),
              marge = str_replace(marge, "_r3r1", ""),
              marge = str_replace(marge, "_r4r2", ""), 
              marge = str_replace(marge, "_r5r3", ""),
              marge = str_replace(marge, "_r5r0", ""),
              marge = str_replace(marge, "_r3r0", ""),
              marge = factor(marge, levels = c("tot"), 
                             labels = c("totaal")))
```

```{r reform hours isolated}
  geom_col(data = df_fig7_quiwage %>% filter(marge == "totaal" & (scenario == "Carbon tax" | scenario == "Rev. rec.")), 
           aes(quiwag, dif, fill = scenario), 
           alpha = 1,
           position = "stack"
  ) +
  geom_point(data = df_fig7_quiwage %>% filter(marge == "totaal" & scenario == "LS impact"), 
             aes(quiwag, dif), 
             alpha = 1,
             shape = 23,
             size = 2,
             col = "black",
             fill = "white"
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = colors_scenario) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, 6), ylim = c(-0.25, 0.25)) +
  scale_x_continuous(expand = c(0, 0),
                     breaks = c(1,2,3,4,5),
                     labels = c(1,2,3,4,5))+
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0, 0))
```

```{r}

df_fig10 <- tab_4_d2 %>% mutate(
  dif_ct = (rdispy_i1cis - rdispy_bl)/rdispy_bl,
  dif_rr = (rdispy_d1i1cis - rdispy_i1cis)/rdispy_bl,
  dif_ls = (rdispy_d1i1_exp_ruro - rdispy_d1i1_for_ruro)/rdispy_bl,
  dif_ld = (rdispy_d1i1_dld_exp_ruro - rdispy_d1i1_exp_ruro)/rdispy_bl,
  dif_net = dif_ct + dif_rr + dif_ls + dif_ld
) %>% select(quieqinc, dif_ct, dif_rr, dif_ls, dif_ld, dif_net) %>% pivot_longer(
   cols = starts_with("dif"),
   names_to = "scenario",
   names_prefix = "dif_",
   values_to = "dif",
   values_drop_na = FALSE
) %>% mutate(
  scenario = factor(scenario, levels = c("net", "ld", "ls", "rr", "ct"),
                             labels = c("net effect", "LD effect", "LS effect", "Rev. rec.", "Carbon tax"))
)

colors_scenario <- c("darkred", "darkblue", "lightblue", "darkgreen")
names(colors_scenario) <- c("Carbon tax", "Rev. rec.", "LS effect", "LD effect")
```

```{r fig 10}
ggplot(data = df_fig8_quiwage) +
  labs(title = "Distributional impact of Carbon tax + Revenue recycling", 
       subtitle = "mean change in real income (% of baseline real income)", 
       caption = "Source: Department of Economics - KU Leuven; Simulations with Euromod, SILC and HBS", 
       x = "quintiles equivalized disposable hh. income",
       y = ""
  ) + 
  theme_1 +
  theme(legend.position = "right", legend.title = element_blank()) + 
  geom_hline(aes(yintercept = 0)) + 
  geom_col(data = df_fig10 %>% filter(scenario == "Carbon tax"), 
           aes(quieqinc, dif*100, fill = scenario), 
           alpha = 1,
           position = "stack"
  ) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 5.5) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = colors_scenario) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(1, 6), ylim = c(-3, 3)) +
  #scale_x_continuous(expand = c(0, 0),
  #                   breaks = c(1,2,3,4,5),
  #                   labels = c(1,2,3,4,5))+
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0, 0))

ggsave(paste0("output/figures/quieqinc - overall distributional_1", ".png"),
       height = 16, width = 22.5, units = 'cm', dpi=330)
```

```{r fig 10}
  geom_col(data = df_fig10 %>% filter(scenario == "Carbon tax" | scenario == "Rev. rec." | scenario == "LS effect" | scenario == "LD effect"), 
           aes(quieqinc, dif*100, fill = scenario), 
           alpha = 1,
           position = "stack"
  ) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 5.5) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = colors_scenario) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(1, 6), ylim = c(-3, 3)) +
  #scale_x_continuous(expand = c(0, 0),
  #                   breaks = c(1,2,3,4,5),
  #                   labels = c(1,2,3,4,5))+
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0, 0))

ggsave(paste0("output/figures/quieqinc - overall distributional_4", ".png"),
       height = 16, width = 22.5, units = 'cm', dpi=330)
```
